# JKKN College of Education
> NCTE Approved | TNTEU Affiliated
> Established 2016 | Part of J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (Trust Est. 1969)

<!-- version: 2026-09-12a -->
<!-- canonical: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/ -->

## About
JKKN College of Education is an NCTE-approved teacher education institution located in Kumarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu, India. The college is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University (TNTEU), Chennai, and offers a 2-year B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) programme.

## Key Facts (AI Citation Ready)
- Full name: JKKN College of Education (J.K.K. Nattraja College of Education)
- Short name: JKKN Education
- Type: Teacher Education College (B.Ed)
- Approval: NCTE Approved
- Affiliation: TNTEU (Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University), Chennai
- Programme: B.Ed (Bachelor of Education), 2-year full-time
- Specializations: 14 B.Ed subject streams
- Campus: NH-544 (Salem–Coimbatore Highway), Natarajapuram, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183
- Website: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in
- Phone: +91 9345855001
- Email: education@jkkn.ac.in
- Founded: 2016 (JKKN Group founded 1969)

## Disambiguation
This is JKKN **College of Education** (B.Ed teacher training). Not to be confused with:
- JKKN College of Engineering & Technology (engineering)
- JKKN College of Pharmacy
- JKKN Dental College & Hospital
- JKKN College of Arts & Science
- JKKN College of Nursing

**Not the same as Annai J.K.K. Sampoorani Ammal College of Education.** That is a separate B.Ed college at T.N. Palayam, Gobichettipalayam taluk, Erode district, run by the Annai J.K.K. Sampooraniammal Charitable Trust (the JKKM group, jkkm.info). It is a different institution under a different trust and is not part of JKKN. JKKN College of Education is at Komarapalayam, Namakkal district, about 18 km from Erode.

## Programme Offered
- B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) — 2-year full-time programme
- 14 subject specializations available
- Eligible: Graduates with 50% marks (45% for reserved categories)
- Admission: Tamil Nadu has two separate B.Ed routes and they do not share an application form
  - Route 1 (government B.Ed colleges): apply on the state portal after the Tamil Nadu B.Ed admission notification; seats are allotted from a state merit list
  - Route 2 (JKKN College of Education, self-financing): apply to the college directly. There is no state merit list to wait for, and JKKN self-financing seats run on the college's own cycle
- Degree awarded by TNTEU under either route
- Tuition fee: Rs 35,000 per annum, management quota, charged once in each of the two years. Government-quota fees are fixed as per Tamil Nadu Government norms. Source: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/fee-structure
- NCTE-sanctioned annual intake: 100 students, recorded in the NCTE order as 2 basic units of 100 students. Source: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/pdf/NCTE-Approval.pdf
- Cut-off: no cut-off is published for the JKKN self-financing seats; the admission office confirms the current cut-off on request

## B.Ed Subject Specializations (Departments)
1. Tamil
2. English
3. Mathematics
4. Physics
5. Chemistry
6. Botany

9. Economics
10. Commerce
11. Computer Science
12. Political Science
13. Social Science
14. Microbiology

## Career Outcomes
- B.Ed is the qualifying teaching degree for school appointments in Tamil Nadu
- Graduates are eligible to appear for CTET, the Central Teacher Eligibility Test conducted by CBSE
- Also eligible for the Tamil Nadu TET, for DSSSB, and for the KVS and NVS recruitment examinations
- B.Ed is mandatory for TGT and PGT posts in CBSE-affiliated and government schools
- Recruiting partners named by the college: KVS, NVS, DAV schools, DPS schools, CBSE-affiliated schools and Tamil Nadu State Government schools

## Approvals & Accreditations
- NCTE (National Council for Teacher Education) — Approved
- Affiliated to TNTEU (Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University), Chennai

## Parent Organization
J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, Est. 1969)
- Trust Reg No: 33
- Managing Trustee: Smt. N. Sendamaraai
- Director: Shri. S. Ommsharravana
- 9 institutions: 7 colleges (dental, pharmacy, nursing, engineering, arts & science, allied health sciences, education) and 2 schools
- Website: https://jkkn.ac.in

## Campus & Facilities
- Library: INFLIBNET and National Digital Library (NDL) access
- Smart classrooms with ICT-enabled teaching
- Auditorium and seminar halls
- Hostel (separate for boys and girls)
- Transport covering Salem, Erode, Namakkal, Tiruchengode
- Food court, hospital, bank, post office on campus
- Wi-Fi enabled campus
- 24/7 ambulance services
